_comment: Scoped seccomp profile for execution-core so bubblewrap (bwrap) can create unprivileged user namespaces (clone/unshare with CLONE_NEWUSER) for sandboxed code execution. Docker's DEFAULT profile blocks userns creation under default settings; this profile uses allow-by-default + an explicit deny-list of escape/escalation syscalls — strictly safer than `seccomp=unconfined`, while still permitting the clone/unshare/mount/pivot_root that bwrap needs. bwrap then re-confines the payload (read-only root, dropped caps, network unshare). Wire via: security_opt: [ seccomp=./seccomp-bwrap.json ] on the execution-core service ONLY.

syscalls.comment: Block container-escape / host-compromise / kernel-module / time / keyring primitives. clone, unshare, mount, pivot_root, umount2, setns are intentionally NOT here so bwrap can build the sandbox namespace.
